notes.notes:
- The game now saves progress when closed.
 - Fixed the UI for Daily Bonuses/Auto Collect.
 - Fixed a bug related to Auto Cloud Save.
 - Fixed the UI for The Treasure event.
 - Small bug fixes (2).

 - Fixed a bug related to Spike Belt, Servants and Seeds.
 - Fixed a visual bug related to Froggy Coins.

 - Small bug fixes (2).
